p: calamities be overpast: This was either the beginning of a certain song, or the words which David uttered when he stayed his affection.
He compares the afflictions which God lays on his children, to a storm that comes and goes.
performeth all things for me: Who does not leave his works begun imperfectly.
heaven: He would rather deliver me by a miracle, than that I should be overcome.
spears and arrows: He means their slanderous and false reports.
Be thou exalted: Do not permit me to be destroyed to the contempt of your Name.
my soul is bowed down: For fear, seeing the great dangers on all sides.
fixed: That is, wholly bent to give you praise for my deliverance.
I will sing and give praise: He shows that both his heart will praise God, and his tongue will confess him, and also he will use other means to provoke himself forward to the same.
clouds: Your mercies not only belong to the Jews, but also to the Gentiles.
